name: Facor Alloys Limited
about: Facor Alloys Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells ferro alloys in India and internationally. It offers silico manganese, ferrochrome, ferrosilicon, ferromanganese, and ferromolybdenum. The company's products are used in the manufacture of steel and stainless-steel. It exports its products to Korea, Japan, Italy, Netherlands, the United States, Turkey, China and Taiwan. Facor Alloys Limited was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Noida, India.
